item.title: Version 1.1.1
item.description:
What's new

  • Calendar: a proper list grouped by account, with colour checkboxes, “Show only this calendar”, and a collapse button that hands the space back to the calendar.
  • Calendar: drag an event to move it (including to another day) and drag its top or bottom edge to change the start or end time. Snaps to 15 minutes.
  • Launcher: type “>” for commands (go, create, ask, toggle) and press Tab for quick actions.
  • Menus: new File, Go and View menus, task-layout and calendar-view switching, and Find in Planner.
  • Shortcuts: create notes (⌘⌥N), events (⌘⌥E), toggle sidebar (⌘⌥S), inspector (⌘⌥I), calendar list (⌘⌥C), and find (⌘F). All rebindable in Settings.
  • AI: ask about any task, note or event from its menu, with a richer set of suggested questions.
  • Performance: faster calendar and lists through per-day caches, cached counts and backlinks, and lazy rendering.
